sets.title: Invoice totals with rename + whitespace interference
sets.description: The same computeTotals method across three billing classes. Carrier A is pristine; carrier B applies RN-05 case_convention (camel_to_snake); carrier C applies both RN-05 (snake_to_camel) and WS-06 line_wrap. Token-based detectors should still identify the clones after normalization.
sets.notes: RN-05 (case_convention) converts snake_case to camelCase and vice versa. WS-06 (line_wrap) reformats call-argument lists across multiple lines. After both transforms, normalization should still reveal the clone relationship. This tests token-based detection resilience.

distractors.reason: near-miss: same invoice line-item vocabulary and foreach-over-items shape, but computes revenue/cost/margin instead of subtotal/tax/total
